steps.content: The dark alley of Drifter Camp is obviously much quieter than the square.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: After all, life is not easy, and everyone gives all the splendor to the square, but there will always be places where the sun does not shine in Drifter Camp.
She leads you around the corner to a small door and knocks. No one answers.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: I'm coming in...
Pushing the door open, she pauses in the small foyer and walks straight to a side door.
It's a small room of less than 4 square feet without a bed, and a woman is lying on a cushion made of rags. Unlike Mia, this is a healthy body, but has a similar aura of death.
...Through those cloudy eyes, you see that her spirit has been captured by some twisted will and is in a nightmare of madness and torment.
Seeing Dudu, she reluctantly opens her mouth.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Oh, no. You're still alive. It's not like I only play tunes for dead people, and look, I didn't even bring my suona today!
She hangs the suona on her back and ambles over to the bed.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: What's your name?
The person lying there struggles to open her mouth.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Furian... That's a great name. You should come to me next time you're celebrating something, and I'll play you a joyful tune.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: I've brought you an expert. He will help you.
steps.female_content: I've brought you an expert. She will help you.

steps.content: She gives her place to you. You nod and kneel beside the woman, and her faint voice crawls into your ears...

steps.speaker: Furian
steps.content: I... had a nightmare... of burning fingerprints... trailing flames... and...

steps.speaker: Furian
steps.content: A monster... A huge, burning one... It-It was howling... It grabbed me...

steps.speaker: Furian
steps.content: Help me...Pl-Please...

You take her hand in yours and close your eyes. The shackles ache vaguely. It's not a feeling a Sinner would bring, it's mental contamination, and you feel the tearing of some kind of evil consciousness.

steps.speaker: Furian
steps.content: Ahhh!!!

Her voice becomes distorted and manic, a familiar sensation comes over you, and you see the scorch marks all over the darkness as your head begins to ache. If this is the warning of the shackles, as Oak Casket said...
It's Mania, and you will enter the nightmare that captured Furian.
